d:
Stellantis has announced a fresh Rs 4,000 crore investment in India which includes 12 launches from Jeep and Citroen by 2030. On this episode of the Autocar Deep Driive Podcast powered by Kotak Prime, Hormazd Sorabjee - Editor, Autocar India - and Ketan Thakkar - Editor, Autocar Professional - discuss the models that could come our way, and Stellantis' plans to turn things around for Jeep and Citroen in India.
Views expressed in this podcast belong solely to the speakers.
